name: active
meaning: 1 while the robot flies its patrol path (anim 1, hum 0xdb), 0 while it is parked (anim 0, hum 0xdc); MSG_SWITCH_ON toggles it (0x4d1427 movzx eax,byte [edx+0x64] / cmp eax,1), Update only steps the path when it is 1 (0x4d13c9)

name: voice
meaning: handle of the looping engine sound; stopped before each new Sound_Play (0x4d148e mov ax,word [edx+0x66] into the Sound_Stop temp) and cleared by Reset (0x4d1a85 mov word [edx+0x66],0)

name: pulseLatch
meaning: 1 between MSG_SWITCH_ON and MSG_SWITCH_OFF; the ON arm does nothing while it is set, so one held switch toggles the robot once (0x4d141a cmp dword [ecx+0x68],0 / 0x4d156a mov dword [eax+0x68],1)

name: killBox
meaning: world-space kill volume rebuilt every active frame around the robot: +-240 on x and z, 400 above pos, ground height below (0x4d1597-0x4d1611 word stores at +0x70..+0x7a); the Wolf gets MSG_KILL when his position is inside it (0x4d16bd call [eax+0x10])

name: traj
meaning: PROPERTY_LAZERROBOT_TRAJ: the patrol trajectory resource (0x4d1219 call Scn_GetPropTrajectory / 0x4d1224 mov [ecx+0x7c],eax); its points are read as traj + 2 + 6*pointIndex (0x4d1725 imul eax,eax,6 / lea ecx,[edx+eax+2])

name: follower
meaning: the 0x20-byte trajectory follower, init'd with headingBias 0x800, continuousHeading 1, use3dDistance 0, arriveRadius 0x32 (0x4d1247 add eax,0x80 before TrajFollower_Init; 0x4d16e0 add edx,0x80 before TrajFollower_Step)

name: vel
meaning: velocity the follower produced this step, in units/s (0x4d16d9 add ecx,0xa0 is TrajFollower_Step's outVel and Vec3s_ScaleByDt's input)

name: step
meaning: vel scaled by the frame time; handed straight to ScnObject_Translate (0x4d16f5 add eax,0xa6 out of Vec3s_ScaleByDt, 0x4d1738 add edx,0xa6 into Translate)

name: pathHeading
meaning: TrajFollower_Step's outHeading slot (0x4d16d0 add eax,0xac); written every step and never read - the robot turns with its own heading at +0xae instead

name: heading
meaning: heading toward the next waypoint, atan2 of the horizontal delta plus half a turn, masked to 0..0xfff (0x4d17b1 add edx,0x800 / and edx,0xfff / mov word [eax+0xae],dx); the turn step then edits it in place before it is copied into rot.y

name: homePos
meaning: the placed position, saved by PostLoadInit (0x4d12b6 add edx,0xb0, 6-byte copy of pos) and restored by Reset through virtual SetPosition (0x4d19a5 add eax,0xb0 / call [edx+0x1c])

name: activator
meaning: the sender of the switch message that last toggled the robot (0x4d1441, 0x4d14dd mov [edx+0xb8],eax); Reset sends it message 0x4d if it is non-NULL (0x4d1a3d push 0x4d)

name: speed
meaning: PROPERTY_LAZERROBOT_SPEED, truncated from the u32 property to a word (0x4d1208 mov dx,word [ebp-0xc] / mov word [ecx+0xbc],dx); passed to TrajFollower_Init by PostLoadInit and again by Reset
